C1007.title: Tang Dynasty Unrivaled S2 Season Star Crystal Dungeon Becomes New Favorite for Gold Farmers
C1007.summary: In July 2022, an experienced gold-farming player shared money-making experience in Datang Wushuang. Players earned in-game currency through multi-account operation, dungeon farming, and equipment resale, then monetized it through trading. The new S2-season Star Crystal dungeon produced tradable star crystals described as high-value hard currency that could generally be sold once obtained; the page referred to about 100 yuan in daily farming income rather than the value of a single star crystal.

references.title: NetEase's Game Cracks Down on Gold Farming Studios for Over a Decade, Yet New Expansion Delights In-Game Currency Farmers
